title: aaye asghar dahar me aur chaarsu tanweer hai
body:
aaye asghar dahar me aur chaarsu tanweer hai
karte hai hum jashne asghar apni ye taqdeer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh kar asghar ko daste sheh pa kehte the adu
ye qamoshi me ali ki bolti tasweer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
aye shahinshaahe atash aye jhoole waale tera naam
naaseraane deen ki fehreest me tehreer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
band mutthi se sitam ko is ne bapa kar diya
pyaase asghar ka tabassum hyderi shamsheer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
wo ha(n)si tune udaai hai qadaawar zulm ki
apni naakaami pa girya hurmala ka teer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mad'he asghar me tabassum aur ghame aghar me ashk
aarzue fatima hai nusrate shabbir hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ek taraf mazloom saabir tashnalab besheer hai
ek taraf zaalim qadaawar hurmala ka teer hai
